## Repository-Wide Mechanisms

### 1. CI Pipeline — GitHub Actions

**File:** [`.github/workflows/test.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/graphql-python-graphql-server@2d5ac9539307d6db22b3364a61063e050c3f20b9/-/blob/.github/workflows/test.yml)

- **Trigger scope** ([lines 7–17](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/graphql-python-graphql-server@2d5ac9539307d6db22b3364a61063e050c3f20b9/-/blob/.github/workflows/test.yml?L7-17)): runs on every push to `main` and on PRs targeting `main`, but only when changes touch `src/**`, `noxfile.py`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, or the workflow file itself. Changes outside those paths do not trigger CI.
- **Concurrency control** ([lines 3–5](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/graphql-python-graphql-server@2d5ac9539307d6db22b3364a61063e050c3f20b9/-/blob/.github/workflows/test.yml?L3-5)): `cancel-in-progress: true` grouped by `github.head_ref || github.run_id`, so superseded runs are cancelled.
- **Dynamic test matrix** ([lines 20–43](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/graphql-python-graphql-server@2d5ac9539307d6db22b3364a61063e050c3f20b9/-/blob/.github/workflows/test.yml?L20-43)): a `generate-jobs-tests` job runs `nox --json -t tests -l | jq …` to enumerate all nox sessions tagged `tests` and emits them as a matrix. This means the matrix automatically reflects whatever sessions `noxfile.py` defines — adding or removing a session in the nox file automatically adds or removes it from CI without modifying the workflow.
- **Test execution** ([lines 45–71](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/graphql-python-graphql-server@2d5ac9539307d6db22b3364a61063e050c3f20b9/-/blob/.github/workflows/test.yml?L45-71)): each matrix cell runs `nox -r -t tests -s <session>` on `ubuntu-latest` with `fail-fast: false` (all sessions run even if one fails). Python versions 3.9–3.13 are pre-installed.
- **Coverage artifacts** ([lines 67–71](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/graphql-python-graphql-server@2d5ac9539307d6db22b3364a61063e050c3f20b9/-/blob/.github/workflows/test.yml?L67-71)): each session uploads `coverage.xml` as an artifact using `if: always()` so coverage is captured even from failing runs.
- **Coverage upload** ([lines 73–84](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/graphql-python-graphql-server@2d5ac9539307d6db22b3364a61063e050c3f20b9/-/blob/.github/workflows/test.yml?L73-84)): a follow-up job downloads all coverage artifacts and pushes them to Codecov with `fail_ci_if_error: true`, meaning a Codecov upload failure fails the CI run.
- **Lint job — commented out** ([lines 86–104](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/graphql-python-graphql-server@2d5ac9539307d6db22b3364a61063e050c3f20b9/-/blob/.github/workflows/test.yml?L86-104)): a `lint` job definition exists but is entirely commented out. It would have run `mypy` via `uv run mypy --install-types --non-interactive --cache-dir=.mypy_cache/ --config-file mypy.ini`. **Mypy is not enforced in CI at this revision.**
